responsibility: Defines the core target macros and ABI/assembler configuration for the Renesas RX backend. It specifies predefined macros, driver specs, data layout, endianness, type sizes, alignment and stack conventions, register classes, addressing and debug defaults, assembler-output macros, PIC/PID and AS100-syntax behavior, and other compile-time target parameters that shape how GCC represents and emits RX code before the hook implementations in rx.cc take over.
same_name_distinction: Provides the compile-time target definition layer for RX: preprocessor macros, ABI/layout constants, register-class and assembler-format macros, and driver specs that configure the port before the hook implementations in rx.cc, the instruction patterns in rx.md, and the option table in rx.opt are used.
